regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a resource-centric market: Gold Miners and Industrial Metals lead with high durability (≥0.87), strong breadth, and all categories narrowing—only 10 of 22 themes are eligible. The absolute-trend gate historically failed to cut drawdown here (mean-reverting tape), so trend eligibility is a caution-only filter, not a return signal. The backtest track record is poor (41% hit rate, 32% directional accuracy), so any directional lean is low confidence.
emerging_watch: Watch for Industrial Metals (512400.SS) to overtake Gold Miners as the top momentum theme with a margin > 0.1 and durability bar > 0.9, accompanied by expanding breadth above 0.95. That would confirm a handoff to base materials, but until then the razor-thin margin (0.018) and narrowing rotation suggest indecision, not a new leadership cycle.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals holds the #2 momentum rank with a high durability bar (0.87) and broad participation (0.92), is eligible under the trend gate, and is not crowded. The macro backdrop of geopolitical headlines may support resource themes, but the detector’s rank is an attention lens, not alpha; the trend gate’s historical lack of drawdown protection here further limits conviction.
theses.dissent: A global growth scare or policy tightening in China could unwind commodity demand and trigger mean reversion, erasing the momentum premium.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.dissent: Targeted government stimulus for new energy vehicles or a surprise export boom could spark a violent snapback rally, especially given oversold conditions.

falsifier.text: 515250.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days.
